C0681.title: Individual User's Normal Cloud Upload Flagged as Violation and Throttled by ISP
C0681.summary: A user reports that while uploading backup files to Baidu Netdisk over a China Mobile broadband connection, the gigabit upload speed was throttled to 5 Mbps and the activity was flagged as a violation. The user questions why normal cloud uploads are deemed non-compliant and why the same behavior did not trigger throttling in other cities.

references.title: Why is personal use of NAS network drives illegal?
